subject: stats: panic in the MergePartitionHist2GlobalHist (#56676)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for planner/statistics only. Change prevents a panic when merging global stats with an empty histogram slice by returning (nil, nil) from `statistics.MergePartitionHist2GlobalHist` on `len(hists)==0`, adds nil-guards before bucket/NDV rewrites in both blocking and async global-stats merge paths, skips sending empty histogram/topN work items in async merge, and adds a regression test (`TestEmptyHists`) that truncates `mysql.stats_histograms` then runs merge with async on/off. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/concurrency within the touched scope.
